public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let dashes be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let mutable output: List of Text be []
  set output to output.append(render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths))
  set output to output.append(render_row(cells: dashes, widths: widths))
  for each row in table.rows
    set output to output.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end
  let newline be "\n"
  return output.join(newline)
end

public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let dashes be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let body be
    for each row in table.rows
    collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)
  let head be [
    render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths),
    render_row(cells: dashes, widths: widths)
  ]
  let lines be head.append_all(body)
  let newline be "\n"
  return lines.join(newline)
end

public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let separator be " | "
  let newline be "\n"
  let header_line be render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths)
  let dashes be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let rule_line be "| {dashes.join(separator)} |"
  let body_lines be
    for each row in table.rows
    collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)
  let lines be [header_line, rule_line].append_all(body_lines)
  return lines.join(newline)
end
